BiblicalUsage: War appears once, in the song of Deborah in Judges 5:8: "They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?" The word is the battle itself, and Deborah says it came because Israel chose new gods.
TheologicalSignificance: To my mind, the verse is the history of Israel in one line: new gods, then war in the gates, and no shield or spear among forty thousand, because the idols could not defend them.
